description: Performance improvements (items 14-15) and UX double-submit prevention (item 16). Remove unnecessary COLLATE clauses from JOINs, consolidate the weekly chart query in index.php into a single GROUP BY query, and add JavaScript double-submit prevention to all forms.
steps: In admin/asistencias.php: Remove 'COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci' from both JOIN conditions (the COUNT query and the SELECT query). Change `a.matricula_alumno COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = al.matricula COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci` to simply `a.matricula_alumno = al.matricula`.

In admin/tutores.php: Remove 'COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci' from both JOIN conditions (COUNT and SELECT queries). Change `t.matricula_alumno COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = a.matricula COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci` to `t.matricula_alumno = a.matricula`.

In admin/dispositivos.php: Remove 'COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci' from the JOIN conditions in the COUNT query, the SELECT query, and the test_notificacion query. Change `dp.matricula_alumno COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = a.matricula COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci` to `dp.matricula_alumno = a.matricula`.

In admin/index.php: Remove 'COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci' from the ultimos_movimientos JOIN. Change `a.matricula_alumno COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = al.matricula COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci` to `a.matricula_alumno = al.matricula`.

In admin/index.php: Replace the loop that runs 7 separate queries for the weekly chart with a single query: `SELECT fecha, SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Entrada' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as entradas, SUM(CASE WHEN tipo = 'Salida' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as salidas FROM asistencias WHERE fecha >= :fecha_inicio AND fecha <= :fecha_fin GROUP BY fecha ORDER BY fecha ASC`. Then fill in the $datos_semana array from the results, using the same format (dia, fecha, entradas, salidas) for any day with no results defaulting to 0.

Add double-submit prevention to admin/includes/footer.php (or if footer.php is already created, add it there): Add a JavaScript snippet that finds all forms on the page and disables the submit button after first click, changing its text to 'Procesando...' and adding a brief timeout to re-enable it after 5 seconds (in case of error). This handles item 16 globally for all admin pages.
acceptance_criteria: No COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci appears in any JOIN condition in asistencias.php, tutores.php, dispositivos.php, or index.php
admin/index.php weekly chart uses a single query with GROUP BY fecha instead of 7 separate queries in a loop
Double-submit prevention JavaScript is present in the shared footer and applies to all forms
php -l passes on all modified files
findings: All COLLATE clauses removed from 4 files (8 occurrences total). Weekly chart consolidated from 7 queries to 1 GROUP BY query. Double-submit prevention added to shared footer.php affecting all admin forms. All PHP lint checks pass.
